blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The agreement between the government and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) could be erased if the peace process remains unfinished, political scientist Yasmira Moner of the Mindanao State University said. This, as President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has yet to meet with the MILF Chairman Al Haj Murad Ebrahim to sign and complete the peace pact. READ: MILF chief seeks meeting with Marcos “A peace process that is not finished, not closed, not signed can be erased,” Moner said in an radio DWIZ interview. “Peace will be complete when we sign the exit agreement,” she added.
